items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: The term 'Old man officer' is mentioned by the Interviewer in a disjointed manner ('Old man officer got a running...') and the Interviewee's response ('To take him in there') does not confirm a personal relationship or even a clear identification of who 'Old man officer' is in relation to the interv

ctx.x: No, that was at the 101 Ranch. We only had string instruments there. And first Minetta was on the piano, then John Bean was on the drum. Old man Bean, Tarcum, on the drum. And I was playing the guitar then. Wasn't I playing? Yeah, I was playing the guitar then. And then we had the old man Willie O'Pri on the clarinet, sax. And we didn't have nothing. We had Jimmy Pala on the violin. Jimmy Pala. I got Jimmy for you. Yeah, you got Jimmy for you.

And then after, a little running come in. Yeah. Old man officer got a running and he had the boys, what they call him, he packs up his instrument. The gold's art. And you went behind and crossed the 25 and that was old John. That was George. That guy right.
